summary: Verified public Expo preview on mobile and authenticated backend regression flows. Login, dashboard, Scout checklist toggle, progression quotas, Bitácora creation, profile save, logout, and API persistence all passed.
action_items: Add data-testid/testID attributes to interactive controls for stable automated regression coverage.
Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL key, or document the intentional EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: The referenced index.tsx has no testID attributes on buttons or inputs, contrary to the mobile testing contract; current tests rely on text and input order.
src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because the public key is configured, but this can break deployments that only provide the required key.
seed_data_creation: Updated the QA user's state with a temporary QA reflection and profile values during persistence testing; no new user was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview https://scout-agenda-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile flow passed at 375x667. Google OAuth was not automated, as expected.
rca_of_issue: No runtime issue reproduced.
